purpose: Evidence behind DEPTH_FLOOR, OPENING_MAX_PERCENT and BAND_EDGES in src/games/vector/generator.ts. Changing an edge invalidates every stored band in the horizon.

rejectionSampling.note: Why boards are carved and not sampled. Fill every blank with a random legal arrow, publish the arrival counts, propagate, reject on a stall. Share of boards that resolve, 6000 seeds at each clue count.
rejectionSampling.conclusion: The 8 to 12 clue range is unreachable by rejection sampling. Boards are carved.

depth.note: The measure PHASE-13-PLAN section 2 named. Four values across 996 boards, which cannot carry seven weekday bands.
depth.conclusion: Retained as a screen at DEPTH_FLOOR 4. Not the band input.

opening.note: Cells assigned in round one, as a percentage of blanks, bucketed by ten.

intensity.definition: floor(100 * sum of per cell assignment rounds / blank cells). The mean round in which a cell was forced, in hundredths.

bands.note: Every band holds more than a year's worth at roughly one accepted board in seven, about 140 carve attempts and 80 milliseconds per day.

firstSessionBoard.note: Below the Monday edge of 217, so the tutorial cannot drift harder than the Monday it precedes.
